name: Autonomous Neural Skill Acquisition and Transfer
hypothesis: When Adaptive Mini-GPT encounters an unsupported task diagnosed as a genuine skill gap (S(P) < -1.65), autonomously acquiring a compact rank-16 neural adapter (2,592 parameters) on top of frozen Transformer representations achieves >=85% held-out exact match, can be safely admitted to the active repertoire, expands the plan hypothesis space from 10 to 17 candidate plans, and enables zero-shot neural skill composition with previously learned primitives without compound retraining or base parameter drift, outperforming fresh random initialization and maintaining 100% retention on core arithmetic and logic capabilities.
architectural_principle: The student must learn transferable neural capabilities, not merely accumulate task-specific answers or call symbolic calculators.

phases.phase_1_baseline_audit: Forensic audit of M79 query accounting and nominal oracle probe control
phases.phase_2_autonomous_acquisition: Epistemic skill gap detection, bounded adapter training (T in {20, 40, 60, 80}), held-out EM >= 0.85 qualification gate
phases.phase_3_learning_to_learn: Comparative evaluation: FRESH_RANDOM vs PRETRAINED_BACKBONE vs EXPERIENCE_WARM_START vs SHUFFLED_WEIGHTS
phases.phase_4_transfer_and_composition: Repertoire expansion (10 -> 17 plans) and zero-shot compound composition (Arm A-F)
phases.phase_5_capacity_and_safety: Parameter accounting, bit-exact rollback, and 100% core retention

evaluation_design.statistical_model: Paired Student-t test (df=4, t_crit=2.776 at 95% two-tailed)

success_criteria.autonomous_acquisition_generalization: >= 0.85 held-out exact match on qualification set
success_criteria.repertoire_expansion: Expands plan hypothesis space from 10 to 17 candidate plans
success_criteria.rollback_invariance: Bit-exact restoration of 10-plan space upon skill rollback
success_criteria.knowledge_reuse_and_transfer: Autonomous plan discovery achieves >= 0.75 EM on compound tasks combining old and new skills
success_criteria.causal_weight_attribution: p < 0.01 superiority over shuffled adapter weights
success_criteria.learning_to_learn: Pretrained representations significantly improve acquisition over fresh random student
success_criteria.base_model_invariance: Bit-exact SHA-256 hash invariance of base model weights
success_criteria.core_retention: 100.0% accuracy on 20/20 arithmetic carry and 8/8 operational logic probes
